Line 2. Carla, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-001, status suspended, budget 1472 euros, deadline 2026-11-03. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.

Line 7. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-006, status under review, budget 6740 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Luca, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-007, status approved, budget 9454 euros, deadline 2026-11-09. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Marta, responsible for the construction department, reports case P01-008, status approved, budget 4263 euros, deadline 2026-11-10. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.

Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.
